title: Telemetry-driven tiering pilot for bidirectional token pricing with streaming minimums
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Summary: Run a telemetry-driven pilot that applies per-direction (ingress/egress) token rates plus an experimental streaming minimum (floor) and an automated grace crediting window. Goal is to learn elasticity, gross margin impact, and support/legal surface area before scaling to stable pricing.

Why now: Sales teams are seeing pushback on asymmetric bills for chat-heavy products; engineering telemetry now exposes per-request input/output split reliably. Finance needs a controlled pilot to estimate ARR impact and enterprise customers requested a fairer per-direction attribution model.

Scope: Hosted API only (not Dedicated/Private). Two simultaneous experiments: (A) apply a small input/output rate differential (ingress discounted by ~10% relative to egress) for a randomized 20% customer cohort; (B) enable a sliding streaming minimum that floors monthly minimal spend at $X but credits unused minutes as grace credits in month+1 for 30 days. Both experiments will be toggled via feature-flag and controllable per-account.

What we will learn: customer sensitivity to per-direction pricing; whether streaming minimums reduce churn for low-volume streaming customers; telemetry signals that best predict bill surprise and support load.

Deliverables: experiment config in billing service, console UI toggle for finance/CS, telemetry dashboards, evaluation report with recommendations and price motion options.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (preflight): data quality checks on per-request token attribution and KV cache effects (2 weeks). Phase 1: small randomized cohort (20% accounts) for 6 weeks, full telemetry capture and weekly check-ins. Phase 2: expand to 50% if no high-risk signals after 6 weeks. Phase 3: recommendation to leadership (scale, iterate, or rollback) and PRD for a broader shipping plan. Feature flags: pricing.variant=bidirectional-test, billing.floor=streaming-grace-30d. Wallet/commit accounts will be excluded from the pilot.

Opt-out: allow enterprise accounts to opt-out via sales ticket or console toggle.

Rollout owners: PM (Maya), Finance lead (Aisha Patel), Billing ENG owner (Ravi Singh), Data/Telemetry (Sofia Moreno), Support (Carlos Vega).
success_criteria: 1) Net revenue change across cohort within +/-5% vs control while reducing bill-related support tickets by >=20%. 2) No more than 2 P1 incidents attributable to pricing logic during pilot. 3) Clear signal in telemetry that per-account input/output ratio correlates with 85% of high-bill disputes. 4) Recommendation produced: scale / iterate / rollback with proposed pricing numbers and runway.
implementation_notes:
Billing: create a directional-rate table that references per-request io split at aggregation time (hourly aggregation job). Streaming minimum: implement a monthly floor with floating grace credits ledger (TTL 30 days). Ensure idempotent migrations and backfill safety. Billing calculation must run in dry-mode first and generate a preview CSV for finance. Add feature-flag gate and rollout API.

Engineering checklist: unit tests for rate calc, e2e on billing pipeline dry-run, migration plan for grace credits table, metric emissions (datadog + bigquery), and automated canary alerts.

Compliance/legal: surface test variant pricing language for enterprise contract and prepare answers for typical security questionnaire questions around billing determinism and audit logs.
